2609.02399.title: Contrastive Explanations in Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks
2609.02399.paper_summary: Argumentation frameworks are useful tools for representing and reasoning with information in a variety of settings, e.g. in supplementing AI models as they perform classification tasks, with a notable benefit of providing additional explainability. In this paper, we introduce contrastive explanations for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAFs), one such formalism. Unlike most existing explanations for QBAFs, which explain the reasoning outcome of a single argument of interest (i.e. a topic argument), contrastive explanations explain the difference between two topic arguments. We introduce a general form of contrastive attribution functions (CAFs) and establish a set of general properties they should satisfy. We introduce CAFs based on removal, gradients and Shapley-values, and study their properties. Finally, to illustrate contrastive explanations, we demonstrate their usefulness in healthcare and bias identification settings.
2609.02399.paper_summary_zh: 論證框架是用於在各種環境中表示和推理信息的有用工具，例如在輔助人工智慧模型執行分類任務時，提供額外可解釋性的顯著好處。在本文中，我們介紹了量化雙極論證框架（QBAFs）的對比解釋，這是一種此類形式主義。與大多數現有的QBAFs解釋不同，後者解釋單一感興趣論點（即主題論點）的推理結果，對比解釋則解釋兩個主題論點之間的差異。我們介紹了一般形式的對比歸因函數（CAFs），並建立了一組它們應滿足的一般性質。我們基於移除、梯度和Shapley值介紹CAFs，並研究它們的性質。最後，為了說明對比解釋，我們展示了它們在醫療保健和偏見識別環境中的有用性。
